messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
**Best month to visit Hawaii: May (late spring) or September (early fall)** | Month | Why it’s great | Typical weather | |-------|----------------|-----------------| | **May** | • Lower crowds than the summer peak.
• Prices for flights and hotels are still relatively reasonable.
• Surf conditions are excellent on the North Shore (especially for beginners).
• The island’s flora is lush and green after the rainy season. | Avg. high: ~82 °F (28 °C)
Avg. low: ~68 °F (20 °C) | | **September** | • Still warm enough for beach days and water sports.
• Hurricane season ends in early September, so the risk is minimal.
• Many locals return to work, so you’ll find fewer tourists.
• Great for whale watching (especially on the Big Island). | Avg. high: ~84 °F (29 °C)
Avg. low: ~70 °F (21 °C) | ### Quick comparison with other months | Month | Crowds | Prices | Weather | Activities | |-------|--------|--------|---------|------------| | **June–August** | High (peak season) | Highest | Warmest | Beach, snorkeling, surfing | | **October–November** | Moderate | Moderate | Slightly cooler | Hiking, whale watching | | **December–March** | Low (off‑season) | Lowest | Mild, occasional rain | Cultural events, winter surf | | **April** | Low | Low | Mild | Surf, hiking, festivals | ### Bottom line If you’re looking for a balance between pleasant weather, reasonable prices, and fewer crowds, **May or September** are the sweet spots. Both months offer warm, sunny days, comfortable evenings, and plenty of activities without the bustle of the summer peak. If you’re a surfer, May is especially good for catching waves on the North Shore, while September is ideal for whale watching and enjoying the island’s natural beauty after the rainy season.
